## Introduction

Import data from the **HELIX project** [@vrijheid2014helix] (Exposome Data Challenge tables) and
prepare the dataset used to analyse the mixture of chemicals in the
downstream analyses (`02_mixtures`, `03_bayesian_models`,
`04_dimensionality_reduction`, `05_omics`).

## Setup

The analysis runs in Julia [@bezanson2017julia]; `ExposomicsJulia` provides the shared helpers and models, together with DataFrames.jl [@bouchetvalat2023dataframes].

```{julia}
#| label: setup
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, CategoricalArrays, StatsBase
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## Data preparation

Load the HELIX tables written by `00_data_ingestion/helix_data_ingestion.qmd`.
Covariates and exposures are joined into one table, one row per child.

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation
covariates = innerjoin(DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "covariates.arrow"))),
                       DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "exposome.arrow"))), on = :ID);
phenotype  = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "phenotype.arrow")));
codebook   = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "codebook.arrow")));
```

Codebook with all the exposures considered (metals shown as an example):

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-2
filter([:family] => (x) -> x == "Metals", codebook)
```

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-3
exposure = filter([:period, :var_type, :domain, :family] => (x, y, z, w) ->
                      x == "Pregnancy" && y == "numeric" &&
                      z != "Covariates" && z != "Phenotype" &&
                      w ∉ ["Built environment", "Natural Spaces", "Noise", "Traffic", "Tobacco Smoke"],
                  codebook);

show(exposure[:, [:variable_name, :domain, :family, :subfamily, :period, :var_type, :labelsshort]],
     allcols = true)
```

Let's consider all the phenotypes and covariates for the analysis.

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-4
cov_pheno = filter([:domain, :period] => (z, w) -> w == "Pregnancy" &&
                       (z == "Covariates" || z == "Phenotype"), codebook)
show(cov_pheno[:, [:variable_name, :domain, :family, :subfamily, :period, :var_type, :labelsshort]],
     allcols = true)
```

Create a unique dataset which contains all the covariates and phenotypes.
We then use this information to compute the **birth weight z-score**
according to *sex*, *gestational age* and *cohort* (which are not
homogeneous). We use only complete observations for non-premature births.

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-5
dt_covar = covariates[:, push!(cov_pheno.variable_name[1:10], "ID")];
dt_pheno = phenotype[:, ["ID", "e3_bw"]];

DT = innerjoin(dt_covar, dt_pheno, on = :ID => :ID)
DT = dropmissing(DT)
DT = DT[DT.e3_gac_None .>= 37.0, :]
show(DT[:, ["ID", "h_cohort", "e3_bw", "h_mbmi_None", "hs_wgtgain_None",
            "e3_gac_None", "e3_sex_None", "h_age_None"]], allcols = true)
```

Select the categories for the gestational age:

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-6
countmap(cut(DT.e3_gac_None, [37, 39, 40, 41, 45]))
DT.e3_gac_Cat = cut(DT.e3_gac_None, [37, 39, 40, 41, 45]);
```

Birth-weight z-score within cohort × gestational-age class × sex
(`add_zscore` from `src/transformations.jl`):

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-7
DT = add_zscore(DT, :e3_bw, [:h_cohort, :e3_gac_Cat, :e3_sex_None]; name = :bw_zscore);
```

Join the dataset with the phenotype and covariates with the dataset of exposures:

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-8
DT = innerjoin(DT, covariates[:, push!(exposure.variable_name, "ID")], on = :ID)
DT = dropmissing(DT);
```

Here a preview of the final dataset with some variables:

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-9
show(DT[:, ["ID", "h_cohort", "e3_sex_None", "bw_zscore", "h_pm10_ratio_preg_None", "hs_hg_m_Log2"]],
     allcols = true)
```

Save the result in `.data/helix/`: the Arrow copy (`clean_dt.arrow`, without
the categorical `e3_gac_Cat` column), read by the downstream analyses.

```{julia}
#| label: data-preparation-10
Arrow.write(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "clean_dt.arrow"), select(DT, Not(:e3_gac_Cat)))
```
